evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; required growth-stage pressure verification is unavailable.
Exhaust O2 was 4.8 ppm early in growth.
Exhaust O2 has risen progressively through 8.4, 13.9, and 16.2 to 21.9 ppm; this raises atmosphere concerns but does not identify a cause.
Temperature 749.8 °C and Ar 99.9 sccm track setpoints, but pressure is unavailable, so normal growth conditions cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning tube pressure measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; validate the rising O2 reading and investigate gas integrity if confirmed. Sample characterization is not yet available.
